### The Society operates through a number of standing committees that work to carry out its mission and to accomplish particular tasks.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Executive Committee

Occasionally, the President, in consultation with the Executive Committee, will also establish ad hoc committees and task forces. 

[Learn more about President and Executive Committee](leadership.html)
:::
```{r}
#| label: leadership_tbl
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(googlesheets4)

# ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gs4_deauth()

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cmts <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17aXj7E4OE-vIgnRkNVZyw8BBjJ1MoXuroS71IqJ9rsI/edit?usp=sharing")

leadership_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16RGHgDI7snPwaHfvF1gxTLAMet1V5_kM_4iHog2h7m8/edit?usp=sharing"
sheet_names <- sheet_names(leadership_url)

combined_data <- bind_rows(
  lapply(sheet_names, function(sheet_name) {
    read_sheet(leadership_url, sheet = sheet_name) |>
      mutate(sheet_name = sheet_name)
  })
)

members <- combined_data |>
  rename(key = sheet_name) |>
  select(key, Position, Name, Email, Term, Additional)

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

obfuscate_email <- function(email) {
  encoded <- base64enc::base64encode(charToRaw(email))
  tags$a(
    href = "#",
    class = "obfuscated-email",
    `data-email` = encoded,
    onclick = "this.href='mailto:'+atob(this.dataset.email);",
    email
  )
}

parse_markdown_links <- function(text) {
  if (is.null(text)) return(NULL)
  if (length(text) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (length(text) > 1) text <- text[1]
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(NULL)

  pattern <- "\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\(([^)]+)\\)"

  if (!str_detect(text, pattern)) return(span(text))

  matches <- str_match_all(text, pattern)[[1]]
  result_parts <- list()
  remaining_text <- text

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(matches))) {
    full_match <- matches[i, 1]
    link_text  <- matches[i, 2]
    url        <- matches[i, 3]

    match_pos <- str_locate(remaining_text, fixed(full_match))

    if (match_pos[1] > 1) {
      result_parts <- c(result_parts, list(str_sub(remaining_text, 1, match_pos[1] - 1)))
    }

    result_parts <- c(result_parts, list(tags$a(href = url, link_text, target = "_blank")))
    remaining_text <- str_sub(remaining_text, match_pos[2] + 1)
  }

  if (nchar(remaining_text) > 0) {
    result_parts <- c(result_parts, list(remaining_text))
  }

  tagList(result_parts)
}

cmt_field <- function(name, content) {
  if (is.null(content)) return(NULL)
  if (is.character(content) && length(content) > 1) content <- content[1]
  if (is.character(content) && (is.na(content) || content == "")) return(NULL)
  tagList(div(class = "detail-label", name), div(content))
}

# ── Row details ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

row_details <- function(index) {
  cmt <- cmts[index, ]

  # Get chair/co-chair rows
  chair_rows <- members |> 
    filter(key == cmt$key[1], Position %in% c("Chair", "Co-chair", "Co-Chair"))

  # Build chair name display
  chair_name <- if (nrow(chair_rows) > 0) {
    paste(chair_rows$Name, collapse = " & ")
  } else {
    cmt$chair[1]
  }

  # Build email content for all chairs
  email_content <- if (nrow(chair_rows) > 0) {
    emails <- chair_rows$Email
    result <- list()
    for (i in seq_along(emails)) {
      email <- emails[i]
      if (!is.null(email) && !is.na(email) && grepl("@", email)) {
        if (i > 1) result <- c(result, list(", "))
        result <- c(result, list(obfuscate_email(email)))
      }
    }
    result
  } else if (!is.null(cmt$email[1]) && !is.na(cmt$email[1])) {
    list(obfuscate_email(cmt$email[1]))
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  detail <- div(
    class = "committee-detail",
    div(
      class = "detail-header", cmt$name[1],
      span(class = "detail-title", paste("Chair:", chair_name))
    ),
    div(class = "detail-description", parse_markdown_links(cmt$description)),
    cmt_field("Responsibilities", parse_markdown_links(cmt$responsibilities)),
    cmt_field("Relation to AP-LS Vision, Mission and Values", parse_markdown_links(cmt$values)),
    cmt_field("Additional", parse_markdown_links(cmt$other)),
    if (!is.null(email_content) && length(email_content) > 0) {
      tagList(div(class = "detail-label", "Contact"), div(email_content))
    }
  )

  if (any(members$key == cmt$key[1])) {
    membership <- tagList(
      div(class = "detail-label", "Committee Members"),
      reactable(
        members |> filter(key == cmt$key[1]),
        pagination = FALSE,
        defaultColDef = colDef(headerClass = "header"),
        columns = list(
          Position   = colDef(name = "Position"),
          Name       = colDef(name = "Name"),
          Term       = colDef(name = "Term"),
          key        = colDef(show = FALSE),
          Email      = colDef(show = FALSE),
          Additional = colDef(show = FALSE)
        ),
        class = "members-table",
        theme = reactableTheme(
          color           = "var(--apls-fg)",
          backgroundColor = "var(--apls-card-bg)",
          borderColor     = "var(--apls-border)",
          cellPadding     = "8px 12px"
        )
      )
    )
    detail <- tagAppendChild(detail, membership)
  }

  detail
}

# ── Table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

tbl <- reactable(
  cmts[, c("name")],
  defaultPageSize = 30,
  onClick = "expand",
  defaultColDef = colDef(headerClass = "header"),
  columns = list(
    name = colDef(
      name = "", minWidth = 250, class = "committee-title",
      cell = function(value) span(title = value, value)
    )
  ),
  details = row_details,
  wrap = TRUE,
  class = "committees-table",
  rowStyle = list(cursor = "pointer"),
  theme = reactableTheme(
    color                  = "var(--apls-fg)",
    backgroundColor        = "var(--apls-card-bg)",
    borderColor            = "var(--apls-border)",
    stripedColor           = "var(--apls-card-bg-alt)",
    highlightColor         = "var(--apls-bg-alt)",
    inputStyle             = list(backgroundColor = "var(--apls-card-bg)"),
    selectStyle            = list(backgroundColor = "var(--apls-card-bg)"),
    pageButtonHoverStyle   = list(backgroundColor = "var(--apls-bg-alt)"),
    pageButtonActiveStyle  = list(backgroundColor = "var(--apls-bg-alt)"),
    cellPadding            = "8px 12px"
  )
)

div(class = "committee-list", tbl)
```
